fusions.name: Thrice-Skipped Pebble
fusions.desc: Skips a flat stone at a target, dealing 13 damage and knocking it back 2 tiles, then skips on to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles for 70% of that.

fusions.name: Churned Mire
fusions.desc: Churns the ground around you to mud, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving them [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Bank
fusions.desc: Raises a bank of earth 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Stony Composure
fusions.desc: When a blow that is not fire lands on you, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
